<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 1"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Community-minded](/Feats.aspx?ID=5275) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Athamaru" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=741" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 19

</column>

---

You are familiar with all the members of your community and their typical movements, and you have learned how to apply these patterns outside those circles. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Perception DC against someone attempting to [Lie](/Actions.aspx?ID=2389) to you and to Perception checks to [Sense Motive](/Actions.aspx?ID=2302) or to detect a creature trying to [Impersonate](/Actions.aspx?ID=2388) someone they are not.
name: Community-minded
